|descr= Sets group speed mode. If unit is passed as param, unit's group is used. Mode may be one of:

* '''"LIMITED"''' (half speed)
* '''"NORMAL"''' (full speed, maintain formation)
* '''"FULL"''' (do not wait for any other units in formation)
